ns2:section.sectionText: Creativity, Innovation and Vision. Creativity is a skill that you can use often, and this course will help you increase your creativity. Studying a mix of theory and practice, you will explore the nature of creativity, how creativity works and how vision becomes reality. You will practice techniques to enhance personal and group creativity. A major semester project will allow you the opportunity to (a) create a product, process or service or (b) create solutions for a nonprofit organization with a self-defined need or opportunity. Open to all majors and levels. For more information, see: http://www.engr.uiuc.edu/moodle/course/
